company.stage: paying pilots (WhatsApp quote desk), Vision AI in pilot

eligibility_notes: Startup age 1 year: inside the 2-year SISFS window and every 'early stage' window.
Founder age 41: no upper age limit on SISFS, MeitY, DST NIDHI, T-AIM, Hub71, YC or Techstars. Only youth-only schemes (some state 'young entrepreneur' awards, PM-YUVA 18–35) are out.
Hyderabad base: Telangana schemes (T-Hub, T-AIM Revv Up, T-Fund, TSIC) and IIIT-H / IIT-H incubators apply.
Gulf inclination: Hub71, Dubai AI Campus, Misk, Startup Qatar, LEAP India pavilion ranked high.
_meta.priority_rule: fit 5 = apply this month; 4 = apply this quarter; 3 = apply when the cash or market need appears; 2–1 = parked.

funds.name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
funds.amount: Up to ₹20 lakh validation grant; up to ₹50 lakh for commercialisation (via an approved incubator)
funds.who: DPIIT-recognised startup ≤ 2 years from incorporation, Pvt Ltd/LLP, ≤ ₹10 lakh prior government funding
funds.why_fit: Souveno is 1 year old and DPIIT-eligible: this is the single best fit for a cash grant; pilots with PSL Polymers / Manikan Cables are the 'validation' story.
funds.notes: Last cycle closed 31 May 2026; incubators (T-Hub, CIE IIIT-H, IITH) accept on rolling windows — the agent watches for the next window. | 11 Sep 2026: Souveno AI Solutions is a PROPRIETORSHIP (PAN BDNPP2011D). DPIIT Startup India recognition is open only to a Private Limited company, LLP or registered Partnership firm, so DPIIT (and everything that needs it: SISFS, 80-IAC, startup pods) is blocked until the business is incorporated as a Pvt Ltd / LLP. Udyam micro registration (UDYAM-TS-02-0251582) is in place, so MSME schemes (PMS, Telangana, IC) are open.

funds.name: DPIIT Startup India recognition + 80-IAC tax exemption
funds.amount: 3-year income-tax holiday (80-IAC), self-certification, IPR fast-track, access to SISFS/Fund of Funds
funds.who: Pvt Ltd/LLP/partnership ≤ 10 years, turnover < ₹100 cr, innovative product
funds.why_fit: Prerequisite for almost every Indian grant below; apply first.
funds.notes: If already recognised, mark done and upload the certificate number in notes. | 11 Sep 2026: Souveno AI Solutions is a PROPRIETORSHIP (PAN BDNPP2011D). DPIIT Startup India recognition is open only to a Private Limited company, LLP or registered Partnership firm, so DPIIT (and everything that needs it: SISFS, 80-IAC, startup pods) is blocked until the business is incorporated as a Pvt Ltd / LLP. Udyam micro registration (UDYAM-TS-02-0251582) is in place, so MSME schemes (PMS, Telangana, IC) are open.

funds.name: MeitY SAMRIDH accelerator (matching funding)
funds.amount: Up to ₹40 lakh, matched 1:1 with the accelerator's investment
funds.who: IT/AI software startup with an MVP and early customers, selected by a SAMRIDH accelerator
funds.why_fit: WhatsApp quote desk has paying pilots; SAMRIDH accelerators (e.g. T-Hub, IIITH CIE, Nasscom) run AI cohorts.

funds.name: MeitY TIDE 2.0 (via TIDE centres e.g. IIT Hyderabad iTIC)
funds.amount: ₹4–7 lakh grant for MVP/prototype, 12 months
funds.who: ICT startup in AI/IoT/vision at an idea-to-MVP stage, through a TIDE centre
funds.why_fit: Vision AI (camera-based attendance, stock, gates) fits the 'emerging tech prototype' brief; IIT Hyderabad's iTIC is a TIDE centre in the home city.

funds.name: DST NIDHI-PRAYAS 2.0 (prototype grant)
funds.amount: Up to ₹20 lakh (up to ₹40 lakh for advanced prototypes)
funds.who: Innovator/startup building a hardware-linked prototype through a PRAYAS centre
funds.why_fit: Vision AI edge box (camera + on-site inference) qualifies as hardware-linked; software-only quote desk does not.
funds.notes: Frame the application around the Vision AI edge device.

funds.name: DST NIDHI Seed Support Programme (via incubators)
funds.amount: Up to ₹1 crore per startup through the incubator
funds.who: Incubated startup with a validated product
funds.why_fit: After incubation at T-Hub / CIE IIIT-H / IITH, this is the next cheque.

funds.name: MSME Innovative scheme (Incubation + IPR)
funds.amount: Incubation: up to ₹15 lakh per idea; IPR: up to ₹5 lakh domestic / ₹15 lakh foreign patent reimbursement
funds.who: Udyam-registered MSE with an innovative idea, via a host institute
funds.why_fit: Patent the Vision AI dispatch-verification method and get the filing reimbursed.

funds.name: MSME PMS scheme (trade-fair stall rent reimbursement)
funds.amount: 80% of stall rent up to ₹30,000 + ₹15,000 contingency per domestic fair
funds.who: Udyam-registered MSE exhibiting at a domestic fair; apply 30 days before
funds.why_fit: Already wired into every exhibit show's subsidy box; apply per show.
funds.notes: Per-show apply-by dates are on each event card.

funds.name: MSME International Cooperation scheme (foreign fairs via association)
funds.amount: Airfare + stall rent reimbursed to the delegation
funds.who: MSE joining a registered association's delegation to a foreign fair
funds.why_fit: Gulfood, Intersec, Middle East Energy: join the FTCCI / EEPC / NSIC delegation.
funds.notes: Next call for Oct 2026 – Mar 2027 events awaited.

funds.name: CGTMSE collateral-free loan (banks/NBFCs)
funds.amount: Collateral-free working-capital / term loan up to ₹5 crore (guarantee cover)
funds.why_fit: Working capital for 20 stalls in a year; bank of the current account can apply.

funds.name: PM MUDRA (Tarun/Tarun Plus) loan
funds.amount: ₹10–20 lakh collateral-free
funds.why_fit: Small, fast, for stall advances if cash is tight.

funds.name: T-Hub incubation / Lab32 (Hyderabad)
funds.amount: Incubation, corporate connects, investor access; route to SISFS/NIDHI/SAMRIDH
funds.why_fit: Home-city incubator; being a T-Hub startup unlocks the SISFS and NIDHI cheques and the Telangana delegations to Gulf fairs.

funds.name: Telangana AI Mission (T-AIM) Revv Up accelerator
funds.amount: Equity-free; government & industry use cases; C-DAC AI compute at no cost; NASSCOM mentoring
funds.who: AI startups based in Hyderabad, ≤ 30 employees
funds.why_fit: Made for Souveno: AI, Hyderabad, small team; government use cases could pilot Vision AI at state warehouses and gates.
funds.notes: Cohorts open roughly yearly; the agent watches for the next call.

funds.name: T-Fund / Telangana State Innovation Cell funding
funds.amount: ₹25 lakh – ₹1 crore (per Startup Grants India)
funds.why_fit: State fund for Hyderabad startups; apply through T-Hub / TSIC.

funds.name: Telangana State Innovation Cell grand challenges / MSME Policy 2024 innovation support
funds.amount: Patent reimbursement, marketing assistance, challenge prizes
funds.why_fit: Marketing assistance already in the subsidy box; patent and challenge tracks on top.

funds.name: CIE IIIT Hyderabad (Deep-tech incubator)
funds.amount: Incubation, MeitY/DST grant access, AI research links
funds.why_fit: Computer-vision research base for Vision AI; SISFS incubator.

funds.name: IIT Hyderabad i-TIC Foundation (TIDE 2.0 centre)
funds.amount: TIDE 2.0 grants, DST seed support
funds.why_fit: Route for the TIDE grant above.

funds.name: Google for Startups Accelerator: India (AI-first)
funds.amount: Equity-free 3-month programme; Google Cloud credits, Gemini/TPU access, mentoring
funds.who: AI-first startups in India, seed to Series A
funds.why_fit: 2026 batch took 20 of 2,000; the WhatsApp + Vision AI combination is exactly the 'AI-first SME' story.
funds.notes: Next call usually opens early in the year.

funds.name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub

funds.name: AWS Activate

funds.why_fit: Hosting for the quote desk and Vision AI inference.

funds.name: NVIDIA Inception
funds.amount: Preferred GPU pricing, DGX Cloud credits, VC exposure
funds.why_fit: Vision AI models on NVIDIA edge (Jetson) and cloud; free to join.

funds.who: Startups with or without VC backing

funds.why_fit: NASSCOM organises the India startup pavilions abroad: membership is the door to those pods.

funds.name: Meta / WhatsApp Business partner & startup programmes

funds.why_fit: Souveno is a WhatsApp Business Platform product; a Meta programme credential also helps at expos.

funds.name: Cisco LaunchPad (India)
funds.amount: Equity-free, enterprise access
funds.why_fit: Vision AI + IoT gates fit Cisco's enterprise/IoT thesis.

funds.name: JioGenNext

funds.why_fit: Reliance's retail/logistics arms are Vision AI buyers.

funds.name: Indian Angel Network / LetsVenture / Inflection Point

funds.amount: Subsidised/free startup pod
